provenance.sourceOrg: Office of the Governor of Georgia
provenance.quote: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption from City of Gainesville independent school district ad valorem taxes for educational purposes in the amount of $10,000.00 of the assessed value of the homestead for residents of that school district?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Exempts $10,000 of a qualifying homestead’s assessed value from Gainesville independent-school-district property taxes, including school bond taxes, beginning January 1, 2027 if voters approve. Assessed value above the exemption remains taxable. It adds to other exemptions for these school taxes and does not apply to state, county, city-purpose or county-school-district property taxes. The resident or an agent must apply to the city or its designee; the exemption then renews while the home remains the resident’s homestead, and recipients must report loss of eligibility.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the additional $10,000 Gainesville school-tax homestead exemption.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed additional school-tax exemption.
